blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — In the limestone forests of Masungi in Rizal Province, a rare plant species believed to have been lost has been rediscovered. The rare species, which is endemic to the Philippines, is now blooming along its Discovery Trail, said Masungi Georeserve as it announced the discovery on Facebook on Sunday, Sept. 13. RELATED STORY: Protecting Masungi: Conflicting views turn area into battleground First collected by Swiss botanist August Loher in the province in 1895, Exacum loheri had been known only from historical collections.
